Preserve the B tournament records-room visual style, full brand wordmarks, Samsung company scope, all correct numbers, desktop record sections and desktop/mobile side-by-side composition. PRIMARY FIX: the mobile page currently ends immediately after the aggregate-history chart and omits required lower sections. Show a COMPLETE long mobile page, not merely its first viewport. Extend the mobile column and the overall board downward enough to include, in this exact order after the existing "등록 종목 합계의 과거 기록": (1) a compact but distinct "대표 보통주 주가 · 삼성전자" chart ending at 74,000원; (2) ruled "기간 통계" with 평균504조 / 최저432조 / 최고549조, labeled 예시 데이터; (3) "연도별 기록" two rows 2025 480조, 2026 연중549조; (4) "전체 이력 CSV" action; (5) collapsed rows "계산식·조회 기준" and "자료 공개 정보"; (6) "가까운 기업 순위" link "2위 SK하이닉스 237조". The bottom navigation belongs at the end of this complete mobile continuation, not over the history chart. Keep section titles and labels readable. Do not just shrink the whole phone to illegibility; enlarge the full image canvas if needed, keeping the desktop screenshot at its current size with clean whitespace beneath it.
SMALL REQUIRED FIXES: add a simple "공유" action by the Samsung title in desktop and mobile. All rank-movement arrows and movement numbers must be neutral dark ink, including the desktop SK하이닉스 ↑1. Preserve the price change +0.80% in red. Company aggregate549조, common495조, preferred54조, composition90.2%/9.8% remain unchanged. Historical registered-member sum remains clearly labeled separately from published current aggregate. No additional tabs, claims, recommendation badges, fake live market data, or invented stock types.
